# E0605: there is no value at the CUE path given for the lineage

The CUE path given with -p parses, but the package has no value there.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
}
```

`data.json`:

```json
{"a": "Argo"}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0605]: there is no value at nothere in lineage.cue
  |
  = help: -p names a field of the package that holds the lineage
```
